name: Chicken Milanese with Tomato & Mozzarella Rigatoni
description: Crisp Parmesan-breaded chicken breast with rigatoni in a garlic-chilli tomato sauce, torn mozzarella, Parmesan and basil.
instructions: Flatten the chicken breast evenly, then flour, egg and coat with breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Fry until crisp and cooked through, then rest on a rack.
Cook the rigatoni and toss with a garlic-chilli passata sauce.
Fold mozzarella and basil through the pasta and serve alongside the Milanese, keeping sauce off the crust.
